## Week 1 · Arrays & Hashing · Math & Simulation (days 1–7)

### Day 1 — Big-O & array basics

`Learn` · Pattern: [Arrays & Hashing](../patterns/arrays-hashing.md)

**Goal:** Analyse time/space of simple loops and solve first problems with a hash map.

**Learn / do:**

- Big-O rules: drop constants, keep the dominant term, nested loops multiply
- Arrays: O(1) index, O(n) insert/delete in the middle, cache-friendly
- Hash map lookups are O(1) average — the most common optimisation from O(n²) to O(n)

### Day 2 — In-place array editing

`Learn` · Pattern: [Arrays & Hashing](../patterns/arrays-hashing.md)

**Goal:** Modify arrays without extra memory using a write pointer.

**Learn / do:**

- Read/write pointer technique for compaction
- Stable vs. unstable removal
- Why swapping with the last element gives O(1) deletes when order doesn't matter

### Day 3 — Hash maps for grouping

`Learn` · Pattern: [Arrays & Hashing](../patterns/arrays-hashing.md)

**Goal:** Use canonical keys (sorted string, count tuple) to group equivalent items.

**Learn / do:**

- Choosing a key that is equal exactly when items are equivalent
- Counting with a fixed-size array vs. a dictionary
- Hash map iteration order caveats

## Week 3 · Prefix Sum · Binary Search (days 15–21)

### Day 15 — Prefix sums

`Learn` · Pattern: [Prefix Sum](../patterns/prefix-sum.md)

**Goal:** Answer range sums in O(1) and count subarrays with a hash map of prefix totals.

**Learn / do:**

- prefix[i+1] = prefix[i] + a[i]; sum(l..r) = prefix[r+1] − prefix[l]
- Count subarrays with sum k via a map of seen prefixes
- Pivot index = left sum equals right sum

### Day 16 — Prefix sums with modular & 2-D variants

`Learn` · Pattern: [Prefix Sum](../patterns/prefix-sum.md)

**Goal:** Extend prefix sums to remainders and matrices.

**Learn / do:**

- Store prefix mod k; equal remainders mean a divisible subarray
- 2-D prefix sums with inclusion–exclusion
